note: Ou & Demsky 2018, §1.3.2: preserving syntactic dependency (dependency ∪ reads-from acyclic) is explicitly 'a strictly weaker guarantee than the previous approach' of forbidding load-store reordering (sequence-before ∪ reads-from acyclic); dependency ⊆ sequence-before, so LSO-permitted executions are a subset of dependency-permitted ones.
